corpus.title: Visit the museum
corpus.text: General admission to the Museo del Prado costs 15 euros. The museum is open from Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm, and on Sundays and public holidays from 10am to 7pm. Admission is free during the last two hours of opening. The Jeronimos entrance is the main access point for individual visitors.
